title: Rooms and voice
tagline: Every room attended becomes checked posts and dated follow-ups, at about two posts a week, with the event pipeline in maintenance.
phase: Maintenance and close-out: router merge, two supervised runs
bottomLine: The event pipeline already produces about two posts a week. This track keeps it there, closes the post-event routing work by 3 December, and clears the stale content queue. Growth in volume is not the goal; finishing what each room starts is.
healthReason: The post-event router is a week ahead of its 3 December target. The risk is a backlog of stale early-November content items, triaged on 20 November.
why: Rooms are where the writing, the community standing and the conversations come from. The pipeline produces well; the gap is finishing: drafts and follow-ups that never close.
mission: Keep research and drafting running for attended events, merge and prove the post-event router, hold the publishing cadence, and clear any content item older than ten days.
destination: On 3 December the router is merged and proven on two supervised runs and the post-event project closes. Through 15 January the cadence holds at about two posts a week, with no content item older than ten days.
showcase: Holding a cadence instead of growing it: a stated target that is deliberately not a growth target
A run ledger and read-only close-check on every post-event run, so a skipped step shows up instead of closing green
Routing each section of a long event brief to a dated follow-up, then measuring how many close in 30 days

milestones.title: Stale content items triaged: keep at most two, cancel the rest
Post-event router merged; first supervised run
Second supervised run; post-event project closed
Eval write-up post goes out through the normal content flow
Cadence held for eight weeks; decide on Long Reads and X on the hub

metrics.label: Posts per week
metrics.baseline: About 2: the pipeline already produces this with no new build

metrics.label: Post-event runs that end with a close-check verdict
metrics.baseline: 0 before 11 November: a failed step could close green
metrics.target: Every new run: PASS, or a skip with a reason

metrics.label: Content items past their due date
metrics.baseline: Grows by about 2 a week with no triage

decisions.decision: Only events marked Going get the full research and content flow; pending events get a footnote unless they meet the event filter.
decisions.why: Holds the cadence without widening the review queue.

decisions.decision: No new X build. The X cuts the drafting skills already produce get posted as they are.
decisions.why: The cheapest way to be on X is to post what already exists.

decisions.decision: The late 'An Obvious week' series is cancelled.
decisions.why: The trial it covered ended 6 November, and a late series has no pilot.

open.question: Which stale recaps are still worth shipping?
open.recommendation: Keep one only if there is uploaded content for it. Cancel the rest.

open.question: Is the planned late-December talk date fixed, and who is the audience?
open.recommendation: If fixed, prep starts 14 December; if not, move it to January.

risks.risk: A busy event week takes a whole session for content.
risks.mitigation: Content runs in one session; the graph track yields its slot that week.

risks.risk: Posts slip in the holiday weeks.
risks.mitigation: One post in each of the two holiday weeks is the plan, not a miss.

assumptions.test: The 30-day close rate, first read 11 December.
